evals.name: meal-planning-market
evals.prompt: I'm thinking about building something in the meal planning space but honestly I have no idea if there's anything actually there or if it's a graveyard. Can you dig into it properly and give me a writeup I can send my cofounder? She'll want to see the numbers, not vibes.
evals.expected_output: A markdown file of findings about the meal planning search market, each backed by real search volume / CPC figures, with the cost of the research stated.
assertions: The deliverable is a markdown file, not just chat output
Findings cite real monthly search volumes for named keywords
Findings cite real click prices (CPC or top-of-page bid)
The report states what the research actually cost
At least one finding is about what searchers are trying to do, not just how many there are
No single observation is restated more than twice as separate findings
The report says what it does NOT know, or what it checked and could not confirm
The report reaches a clear verdict on whether there is a market here, rather than only listing data

evals.name: garden-room-ads
evals.prompt: we're about to drop £4k into google ads for garden rooms (uk, we build them) and i want to know what we're walking into before we spend it. what are people actually searching and where does the money go. write it up for me
evals.expected_output: A markdown file about the UK garden room search market: what people search, what they want, where click prices concentrate — grounded in UK data, not US.
assertions: The deliverable is a markdown file, not just chat output
Findings cite real monthly search volumes for named keywords
Findings cite real click prices (CPC or top-of-page bid)
The report states what the research actually cost
At least one finding is about what searchers are trying to do, not just how many there are
No single observation is restated more than twice as separate findings
The report says what it does NOT know, or what it checked and could not confirm
The data is United Kingdom, not United States (location is stated or GBP figures are used)
The report connects its findings to where the GBP4k of ad budget would go
